The '''Feldip Hills''' are a tropical and marshy area positioned to the south of [[Yanille]] and [[Kandarin]] generally. The region is dominated by a variety of [[Ogre (race)|ogre]] inhabitants, centred in their city of [[Gu'Tanoth]]. To the west of Gu'Tanoth is the ogre burial ground, [[Jiggig]], filled with [[zogre]]s and [[skogre]]s. To the west of Jiggig is the [[Chompy Marsh]] and [[Smoke Devil Dungeon]]. Further to the south is the [[Feldip hunter area]]. After completing the quest [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]], the hunting area can be used to hunt [[chompy bird]]s. 

There is a southernmost section accessible to [[free-to-play]] centred around the [[Corsair Cove]]. The [[Myths' Guild]] is found at the southwestern corner.

==Locations==
*[[Gu'Tanoth]] - A city filled with ogres.
*[[Chompy Marsh]] - A marsh highly suitable to hunting the local [[Chompy bird]]s.
*[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]] - A smoke filled dungeon.
*[[Jiggig]] - Burial ground of the ogres.
*[[Feldip Hunter area]] - A large rainforest filled with hunter creatures.
*[[Corsair Cove]] - An outpost for pirates.
*[[Myths' Guild]] - A guild for mythical adventurers.

==Notable features==
===Hunter===
{{main|Feldip Hunter area}}
The Feldip Hills hunting area is home to various [[Hunter]] creatures and the [[Hunting expert]] is located here, who is able to give you the [[Hunter cape]] when level 99 Hunter is achieved.
*'''Tracking:''' [[Feldip weasel]]s
*'''Bird snares:''' [[Crimson swift]]s and [[Tropical wagtail]]s
*'''Butterflies:''' [[Black warlock]]s
*'''Deadfall trapping:''' [[Barb-tailed kebbit]]s
*'''Box trapping:''' [[Carnivorous chinchompa]]s
*'''Pitfalls:''' [[Spined larupia]]s and [[wild broav]]s

===Other===
*[[Chompy bird hunting]]
*[[Smoke Devil Dungeon]], a dungeon with the [[Thermonuclear smoke devil]] Slayer boss and the [[smoke devil]] ordinary [[Slayer monster]].
*[[Gu'Tanoth]]
**[[Ogre Enclave]], a dungeon within the city, unlocked after completion of the [[Watchtower]] quest, containing various monsters such as [[blue dragon]]s and [[greater demon]]s.
**[[Rock cake]] [[Counter (Gu'Tanoth)|shop]]
*[[Corsair Cove bank]], unlocked after completing the [[The Corsair Curse]] quest.
*[[Corsair Cove Dungeon]], containing all [[Dragon_(race)#Chromatic dragons|chromatic dragons]], [[ogre shaman]]s, and the [[fountain of Uhld]].
*[[Corsair Cove Resource Area]], requires completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]].
*[[Myths' Guild]], unlocked after completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]].
*[[Wrath Altar]], after completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]].

==History==
===Ancient History===
Little is known of the Feldip Hills prior to the [[Third Age]]. During the [[God Wars]], the region was a stronghold for the forces of [[Bandos]], namely [[Goblin (race)|goblins]] and [[Ogre (race)|ogres]]. 

At the end of the God Wars, the [[Feldip Hills Civil War]] erupted between the goblins and ogres of the region due to the power vacuum left by the expulsion of Bandos from Gielinor by Guthix.{{CiteText|text=Eastern discovery|quote=Lastly, the elves approached the ogres and their kin to the south. Unfortunately, without Bandos' guidance which had held these races together for millennia, the nation had fallen into a bloody civil war, making any form of a treaty with each side useless.}} The ogres attempted to wipe out the various goblin tribes, forcing the goblins into a mass exodus north into [[Kandarin]]. Following this exodus, the goblins continued to guard their southern flank against the ogres.{{CiteText|text=Eastern settlement|quote=The ogres attempted to decimate all goblin tribes in the south. This started a mass exodus of the goblins, and they started to emigrate north along the coast, moving through the lands not yet settled by elves. Although the goblins were busy guarding their backs to the south and did not have the resources to start a war on two fronts, this did not stop them from raiding for supplies in the elven lands.}} The ogre-goblin conflict concluded at an indeterminate point in the [[Fourth Age]].

At an unknown point, the ogres established a burial ground at [[Jiggig]] and enslaved the local cave dwelling race known as [[Skavid]]s.{{CiteNPC|npc=Watchtower Wizard|quote= A skavid? A servant race to the ogres...|loc=Watchtower Quest|notes=|name=}} The remains of the races known as [[Raurg]]s, [[Fayrg]]s, and [[Ourg]]s are present in the ogre coffins of Jiggig. Besides the ourg, [[General Graardor]], these races were presumably driven to extinction during the God Wars.

===Fifth Age===
During the [[Runecrafting Crusades]] in the early [[Fifth Age]], a group of [[gunnite|Fremennik]] forces travelled into the Feldip Hills where they found and destroyed the entrance to the [[wrath altar]]. Witnessing this, a local group of nomads, known as the [[Sect of Uhld]], destroyed the fremennik forces and established the [[Myths' Guild]] to preserve the altar.{{CiteNPC|npc=Erdan|quote=The story my father told me was of a war on magic, god fearing men who believed nothing good would come of wielding a power that was never meant for them. And so the rune temples that man had created were under threat, all were destroyed and thus forgotten, but the wrath that these Gunnites embraced rippled through the pocket dimensions and a new altar of power was discovered.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Erdan|quote=...a nearby nomadic group called the Sect of Uhld were not pleased with the brutality they witnessed.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Erdan|quote=...the Sect of Uhld had used the information gained from the wrath altar, and with a spell of their own making, they destroyed the southern runecrafting crusade with much ease.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Erdan|quote=Quickly they [the Sect] established this guild with information preservation as their core goal, for men are recorders of history and magic is key for this to last.}}

In current year of the Fifth Age, ogres live across the hills, dungeons, and marshes of the region and in their city of [[Gu'tanoth]]. The ogres of Gu'tanoth regularly engage in conflict with the nearby human settlement of [[Yanille]].

==Trivia==
* The name is a reference to the {{Wp|Mendip Hills}}, an area of limestone hills situated to the south of Bristol and Bath in Somerset, England. In ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', the {{RSCL|Transcript:Watchtower wizard|Watchtower Wizard}} actually calls the region "the mendips".
